messages:
ana: Quick heads-up 1: customer reported cost dashboard moving cache savings between routes when a session crosses billing slabs.

pete: Yup. Repro: prefetch tokens show in slab A, later hits in slab B, daily per-route rollups shift.

zoe: Are we emitting any session linkage from econ? I thought we only emit slab-keyed aggregates.

ana: econ currently returns rows keyed by billing_window_start + route. No session id.

pete: Proposal: emit an optional `carryover_hint` boolean on hit rows so UI can offer "session-attributed" view while keeping slab totals unchanged for billing.

zoe: Sounds safe. How to compute cheaply? Two ideas: (1) small sampled session map (0.5%-1%) exported nightly, UI extrapolates; (2) lightweight streaming map for active sessions (more infra).

ana: Sampling seems fastest to ship. Add a "sampled" badge and a tooltip that says invoices use raw slabs.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: econ-prefetch-schema migration scheduled to staging in ~20m: https://deploys.internal/redwood/abcd

pete: Plan: pete -> proto PR with `carryover_hint` and example payload, zoe -> run sampling sim and post error margin, ana -> mock minimal UI toggle + tooltip. Sync tomorrow 10:30.

zoe: starting sim now, will post numbers.
